B.
The thermoacoustic approximation of the piston effect
This section is devoted to analyze the piston effect in supercritical fluids via the developed scheme. In this case the
duration of excitation is much longer than the acoustic time scale. Therefore, wave propagation occurs only at the
beginning of the process until the initial pressure disturbance reaches the other end of the pipe, correspondingly, no
reflection takes place. In order to prove the intensive effect of thermal expansion near the critical point, we present
the same phenomenon with same dimensional excitation parameters for an ideal gas state, too.
